notes: Scan session ledger built and verified. A scan is now a bounded, auditable unit of work — it records its plan, records every outcome against it with a failure reason, and is not complete until every planned row is terminal. Retry is part of the session; artwork shares the same ledger. Verified across a four-phase device regression with five kills in three pipeline phases, UNACCOUNTED 0 throughout, plus a 20-test unit suite that was itself proven by deliberately breaking the scanner and confirming the right half went red. Header read timeout 15s -> 5s. Also collapsed two session identifiers into one and made the log session tag task-local.
